item.title: Show HN: A Planet and Geology Simulation Sandbox Game in Godot
item.summary: I'm a huge geology nerd and a software developer. I always wanted to try building a sandbox game inspired by Sim Earth. I also was heavily inspired by the Deep Time maps of Ron Blakey. This project just got to the point where the simulator runs result in realistic planetary life histories, it's not done by any means but I think it's pretty entertaining to run through simulations and watch the planets evolve. It's in early access and totally free, maybe if I ever make the gameplay really fun and have enough content to be worth it maybe it will be a real game, but for now its just a cool planet simulator. Open to any feedback on systems in the simulation you think would be cool to include or enhance. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49237321 Points: 2 # Comments: 0
